event_text: During the Gathering, m_c makes an off-color comment about o_c_n's baron, much to o_c_n's shock.
During the Gathering, m_c pointedly excludes o_c_n's baron from the discussion amongst the barons on the baron's perch.
o_c_n runs late to the Gathering, and m_c encourages the other barons to start without them.
During the Gathering, m_c sighs loudly whenever o_c_n's baron speaks.
At the Gathering, m_c pretends to have forgotten o_c_n's baron's name, much to their disbelief.
Before the Gathering, m_c counsels {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clan to begin cutting ties and ending friendships with o_c_n clippers. The tension hanging over this Gathering makes it clear o_c_n notices.
During {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} speech at the Gathering, m_c reveals one of o_c_n's weaknesses that o_c_n's baron told {PRONOUN/m_c/object} in confidence.
At the Gathering, m_c flatly ignores o_c_n's baron when they try to make small-talk.
m_c barges in front of o_c_n's baron at the Gathering, cutting them off and insisting that m_c be the first to deliver news.
At the Gathering, m_c questions whether o_c_n's baron has been entirely truthful about their recent activities on their shared border.
During the Gathering, m_c keeps talking over o_c_n's baron.
During o_c_n's baron's Gathering speech, they bring up a recent death in the Clan. m_c hurries the other baron along, reminding them that the other Clans don't care.
When o_c_n's baron shares their news at the Gathering, m_c repeats bits of it in a singsong.
At the Gathering, m_c asks after the health and prosperity of each baron's Clan... except o_c_n.
m_c spends {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Gathering speech making small barbs at o_c_n's baron - not enough to warrant confrontation, just enough that o_c_n's baron feels the prick.
While getting to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} spot before beginning the Gathering, m_c steps on the tail of o_c_n's baron. m_c gives no apology for the perhaps-not-quite mistake.
When the o_c_n baron steps up to sit beside m_c at the Gathering, m_c turns {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head away pointedly.

Another Clan's baron accuses o_c_n at the Gathering of refusing to share herbs in the case of a sick kitten. m_c turns on o_c_n's baron immediately, hissing that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} cannot ally {PRONOUN/m_c/self} with fox-hearts.
o_c_n's medicine cats present a new prophecy at the Gathering. m_c offends o_c_n by interrupting to offer {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} interpretation before the medicine cats can say anything else.

Before the Gathering, m_c has a fleeting vision of gnashing teeth and coarse black-and-white fur, along with the scent of o_c_n and blood. At the Gathering, m_c jokes that o_c_n is really badgering c_n about this alliance. o_c_n's baron's face darkens.
At the Gathering, a spirit from o_c_n murmurs in m_c's ears, requesting that their message be passed on to o_c_n's baron. m_c ignores the spirit, who disappears with a frustrated hiss.

At the Gathering, m_c remarks on how o_c_n might need some nest-weaving tips from c_n, since o_c_n is still making nests from crabgrass and dandelion leaves. To no cat's surprise, o_c_n's baron takes offense at that.

At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron reports that one of their cats' broken bones has finally healed. m_c scoffs and addresses the o_c_n medicine cats, telling them that they should have re-broken the bone and set it better.

At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron vents to m_c about how o_c_n apprentices don't help out enough around camp. m_c scoffs, saying {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} would never permit such unruly behavior, because camp-keeping is a fundamental part of c_n apprenticeship.
m_c grins as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/spout/spouts} insults at o_c_n's baron during the Gathering.

Cats tend to let their guards down around m_c due to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} quiet nature, which allows {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to notice the few o_c_n clippers who scowl whenever their baron speaks at the Gathering. m_c brings this up to o_c_n's baron and asks if they need help controlling their clippers.

During {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Gathering speech, m_c brings up some of o_c_n's unsavory history. o_c_n's baron politely asks {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to stop, and m_c asks if o_c_n is trying to rewrite history.

m_c is intentional with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} comments during the Gathering. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/manage/manages} to make it clear to o_c_n that c_n is no longer their ally - without being outright insulting.
At the Gathering, m_c rebukes o_c_n's baron for merely driving out the troublemaking rogues on their border instead of slaughtering every last one of them.
During the Gathering, m_c is constantly singing o_c_n's praises. The other barons don't seem so impressed, but o_c_n's baron is quite pleased.
Before the Gathering officially starts, o_c_n's baron and m_c bend their heads together to gossip like starlings.
At the Gathering, m_c goes on and on about a small favor that o_c_n did for c_n. o_c_n's baron beams.
At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron discusses a problem with a dog near their border. m_c is quick to volunteer c_n's clippers as reinforcement, should the need arise.

At the Gathering, m_c shares a dream {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had the previous night about o_c_n and c_n thriving and strengthening each other. o_c_n's baron amazedly reports they had the exact same dream.

At the Gathering, m_c spots the moonlit gleam of eyes at the edge of the meeting place. The intruder turns tail and flees, but m_c launches {PRONOUN/m_c/self} off the baron's perch and gives chase, then returns a few heartbeats later with droplets of blood clinging to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} whiskers and a satisfied look. o_c_n's baron grins approvingly.
At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron grouses about disobedient apprentices. m_c urges them to lay down the code and keep them in line.

At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron speaks at length about the perseverance of one of their medicine cats in caring for a seriously injured Clanmate. m_c feels it would be too awkward to congratulate o_c_n directly, but nevertheless nods to the medicine cat in question.

At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron mentions a battle o_c_n clippers won against a local rogue gang. m_c makes a glowing comparison between those clippers and legendary heroes of o_c_n myth. o_c_n's baron is pleased and impressed by m_c's knowledge.

At the Gathering, m_c fills the ears of o_c_n's baron with flattering rhetoric about how c_n could enable o_c_n to dominate the territories. o_c_n's baron listens attentively, never noticing the shadow flickering behind m_c, too dark to be cast by the moon's light.

At the Gathering, m_c silkily describes a future where o_c_n and c_n rule all the territories together, using all {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} skill in advising. The eyes of o_c_n's baron glaze over, taken by the vision m_c weaves.

While trying to scramble up onto the baron's perch at the Gathering, o_c_n's new young baron slips and scrabbles with their hindlegs for purchase. Thinking fast, m_c grabs their scruff and lifts them onto the perch easily. o_c_n's baron breathlessly thanks {PRONOUN/m_c/object}.
At the Gathering, m_c tells o_c_n's baron that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/think/thinks} o_c_n looks stronger than ever.
m_c takes {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} chance at the Gathering to fawn over o_c_n's baron for everything from their apprentices' manners to their medicine cats' intelligence.
When o_c_n arrives at the Gathering, m_c notices that o_c_n's regent is leading the patrol instead of their baron. m_c is the first to wish o_c_n's baron a speedy recovery, and the regent smiles.
At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron proudly announces they have welcomed new kits. m_c congratulates them first and wishes for the health and happiness of both the parents and the litter.
At the Gathering, m_c informs o_c_n's baron that c_n apprentices idolize o_c_n clippers.
During the Gathering, m_c's is the first and loudest laugh whenever o_c_n's baron makes anything even approaching a joke.

During the Gathering, m_c comments that the spirit of one of o_c_n's clippers came to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to tell {PRONOUN/m_c/object} what a great job o_c_n's baron is doing. m_c avoids mentioning the shadows gathered like cobwebs on the spirit's pelt.
m_c spends all moon working on a grass weaving of o_c_n's symbol and proudly presents it to o_c_n's baron at the Gathering. o_c_n's baron is amazed by the gift.
m_c compliments o_c_n's newest clippers at the Gathering.

Before the Gathering, m_c takes o_c_n's baron aside and warns them that their mate will be caught in a flood in the next moon, unless o_c_n's baron moves their camp to high ground. o_c_n's baron is shocked and grateful for m_c's clairvoyance.

Before the Gathering, m_c murmurs to o_c_n's baron that in the next moon, another Clan will suffer a greencough outbreak. This could make a great opportunity for o_c_n and c_n to seize some more territory and split it between them.
At the Gathering, m_c praises o_c_n's baron for how sharp o_c_n clippers' claws are, be it for hunting or fighting. o_c_n's baron is all the more pleased to hear that from a baron like m_c.

m_c realizes the full moon has risen and {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Gathering patrol is still in camp. m_c leads c_n in a wild sprint to the meeting place, where o_c_n's baron has convinced the others to wait. m_c thanks them profusely, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} fur sticking up in all directions.

At the Gathering, m_c remarks that o_c_n is on its way to rivaling c_n. o_c_n's baron purrs, knowing m_c's reputation for having a bit of an ego; this is as flattering a comparison as they could ask for.
m_c admits to o_c_n's baron at the Gathering that they're exactly the sort of baron {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/hope/hopes} to be.

Given o_c_n's reputation of battle-readiness, m_c decides to praise the power and strength of o_c_n's clippers at the Gathering. The appreciative gleam in o_c_n's baron's eye suggests this was the right course of action.

Given o_c_n's reputation of warm-hearted sociability, m_c decides to praise the wisdom and rationality of o_c_n's mediators at the Gathering. The appreciative gleam in o_c_n's baron's eye suggests this was the right course of action.

Given o_c_n's reputation of cool pragmatism, m_c decides to praise the intelligence and skill of o_c_n's medicine cats at the Gathering. The appreciative gleam in o_c_n's baron's eye suggests this was the right course of action.

Another baron during the Gathering makes scathing comments towards o_c_n. m_c skillfully redirects their words into praise for o_c_n; o_c_n's baron sends an appreciative, though appraising, glance to m_c.
Another baron during the Gathering makes scathing comments towards o_c_n. m_c skillfully redirects their words into praise for o_c_n; o_c_n's baron seems appreciative.

At the Gathering, m_c tells the story of a Clan that supported another through the darkest time in their shared history - even to great personal cost. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/announce/announces} that just like the mythical Clan, c_n will never abandon their ally.
At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron confesses that a problem is plaguing their Clan. They're surprised when m_c offers a very competent solution despite {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} usual childish antics.
At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron announces that their medicine cats received an omen. m_c proposes an extremely literal interpretation, which the medicine cats admit they hadn't considered.
At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron announces that their medicine cats received a prophecy. m_c proposes an extremely literal interpretation, which the medicine cats admit they hadn't considered.
The night before the Gathering, m_c and o_c_n's baron share a dream of being kits again, playing mossball and tag. At the Gathering, m_c is pleased to see o_c_n's baron looking lighter.

At the Gathering, m_c approaches o_c_n's baron and pays them a heartfelt compliment. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} may not be a cat of many words, but when {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/use/uses} them, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/make/makes} them count.

At the Gathering, m_c announces that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/believe/believes} StarClan intends for o_c_n and c_n clippers to go on a quest together. o_c_n's baron is surprised, but agrees to send out a joint patrol to explore this possibility.

At the Gathering, m_c speaks with o_c_n's medicine cats about a prophecy they received, offering valuable insight about the threat o_c_n faces. m_c encourages o_c_n's baron to take immediate, violent action and snuff out this threat.

m_c speaks to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates before the Gathering, making it clear what tonight's goal is. When c_n arrives at the Gathering place, they all disperse to find o_c_n cats and take advantage of their prideful nature.
m_c makes a point to praise o_c_n's strong and mighty clippers during the Gathering.
At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron gets into a spat with another baron. m_c silently hears out both sides and then proves o_c_n's baron is right with cool logic.
At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron and m_c put their heads together to discuss the weaknesses of their enemies. o_c_n's baron is impressed by m_c's insight.
During the Gathering, m_c has a lot to say about o_c_n's recent patrols near c_n borders, and none of it is good.
During the Gathering, m_c goes on and on about a tiny incident on the border c_n and o_c_n share, really making a prophecy out of a pawprint. o_c_n's baron seems increasingly irritable.
At the Gathering, m_c greets o_c_n's baron with a sneer and nothing else. o_c_n's baron says nothing, but their hackles rise.
o_c_n and c_n arrive at the Gathering at the same time. m_c ignores o_c_n's baron's greeting and enters the meeting place first without a backward glance.

Every cat always told m_c {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} would get in trouble for {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} smart mouth... but no cat could've predicted how useful it would be in this situation. By the end of the Gathering, o_c_n's baron seems ready to claw {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} face off.

m_c senses a presence from beyond the grave hovering around o_c_n's baron at the Gathering, and makes sure to bring up this dead Clanmate every chance {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/get/gets}, just to get under o_c_n's baron's skin.
As o_c_n's baron announces new apprentices at the Gathering, m_c interrupts to offer plenty of unsolicited advice about how best to train an apprentice.

During the Gathering, m_c sits apart from the other barons and watches the sky. When {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/notice/notices} a wisp of cloud drift over the full moon, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/interrupt/interrupts} and {VERB/m_c/warn/warns} that StarClan is displeased - in the middle of o_c_n's baron's speech.
During o_c_n's baron's Gathering speech, m_c interrupts frequently, finishing o_c_n's baron's sentences. By the end of the night, o_c_n's baron is looking irritated and uneasy.

During the Gathering, m_c compares o_c_n's actions to the legacy of a mythological villain. o_c_n's baron hisses and asks if m_c is insinuating something. m_c stares at them and answers that yes, {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is}.
When o_c_n's baron explains the treatment of a badly injured clipper at the Gathering, m_c interrupts to instruct the medicine cats of o_c_n on a better course of treatment.
At the Gathering, m_c accuses o_c_n's baron of using loners and rogues to spy on c_n.

During the Gathering, m_c says nothing to the other barons all night, until the end of the Gathering - at which point {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/gaze/gazes} dreamily into the distance and {VERB/m_c/warn/warns} o_c_n's baron that a storm in brewing for their Clan in the coming moon.
At the Gathering, m_c refuses to leave enough space on the baron's perch for o_c_n's baron, forcing them to deliver their Clan news from an awkward spot closer to the ground.
While o_c_n's baron discusses serious threats on o_c_n's border at the Gathering, m_c scoffs and shoots disbelieving looks at other barons.
m_c responds to everything o_c_n's baron says at the Gathering with a skeptical look and an undermining comment.
At the Gathering, m_c gossips on the baron's perch about o_c_n before they arrive. When o_c_n's baron arrives and joins them on the baron's perch, the other barons keep their distance.
When o_c_n's baron announces new clippers at the Gathering, m_c is pointedly silent while the others cheer and welcome the new clippers.

During the Gathering, o_c_n's baron delivers their news of a border skirmish. m_c grumbles under {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} breath about lazy, undisciplined fighting styles, and how o_c_n's clippers can hardly be called clippers at all.
During the Gathering, m_c makes a surprise outburst about how o_c_n has had the other Clans under their paw for far too long, and it's time for c_n and their allies to rise up against o_c_n.
During the Gathering, m_c spits accusations at o_c_n's baron.
During the Gathering, m_c comments unprompted that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} could easily take on two o_c_n clippers at once in a fight.
During the Gathering, m_c 'jokes' that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} probably caught more prey this moon than all of o_c_n combined.
During the Gathering, m_c comments that it's a pity to see what has become of o_c_n in recent moons. They used to be such a well-respected Clan...
During the Gathering, o_c_n's baron announces the birth of new kits. m_c implies that o_c_n clippers are not fit to be parents, drawing hisses and caterwauls from o_c_n.
During the Gathering, m_c asks o_c_n's baron earnestly if they really think they're living up to o_c_n's legacy. o_c_n's baron frowns at the implication.
During the Gathering, m_c asks o_c_n's baron if o_c_n teaches its apprentices killing blows, or whether the Clan is full of mouse-hearts that would rather roll over and show their bellies.

During the Gathering, o_c_n's baron brags about recent successes in border skirmishes. m_c remarks that they're obfuscating how badly wounded some clippers are and how overworked their medicine cats seem.

During the Gathering, m_c wrinkles {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} nose and demands to know why o_c_n's baron stinks of lavender. o_c_n's baron looks wounded and replies that their dead mother used to wear lavender on her pelt.
During the Gathering, m_c suggests to o_c_n's baron that one of their weaker-looking clippers will probably not survive the next leaf-bare.
During the Gathering, m_c brings up a shameful piece of o_c_n's past at an inopportune moment, much to the annoyance of o_c_n's baron.

During the Gathering, m_c launches accusations at o_c_n clippers of prey-stealing. The o_c_n clippers below howl their outrage, and o_c_n's baron tries to interrupt m_c, but {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/bluster/blusters} on, ignoring them
During the Gathering, o_c_n's baron references an o_c_n myth. m_c jumps to the end of the story and remarks on what a mouse-brain a cat would have to be to believe it.
At the Gathering, m_c makes a comparison between the story of a misbehaving c_n apprentice and o_c_n's behavior at their shared border. o_c_n's baron hisses at the implication
Knowing how o_c_n values strength in battle, m_c weaves some innocent remarks about how mouse-hearted o_c_n's newest apprentices seem. o_c_n's baron's claws slide out.

Knowing how o_c_n values good manners and strong inter-Clan relationships, m_c comments on how difficult of a time o_c_n seems to be having when it comes to controlling their misbehaving apprentices. o_c_n's baron's eyes narrow.
Knowing how o_c_n prides itself on being a clever, discerning Clan, m_c brings up recent rogue activity that o_c_n's baron has failed to take action on. The fur along o_c_n's baron's spine rises.

m_c was told {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} too smart for {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} own good. But when the goal is getting under another cat's fur, m_c is exactly the right cat for the task. This Gathering is very productive; o_c_n's baron is spitting by the end.

Being a quiet observer means m_c notices things other cats don't - such as the tense looks between o_c_n's baron and regent. In the middle of the Gathering, m_c pipes up and asks if something's wrong in o_c_n's baronship, blinking innocently at them.

At the Gathering, dark whispers rush through m_c's voice like a cold wind through dead branches. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/warn/warns} o_c_n that they are making an enemy of c_n - and it could be their last mistake.

At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron announces their interpretation of a prophecy received by their medicine cats. m_c counters this with another interpretation and challenges o_c_n's medicine cats to admit which interpretation is more plausible. The medicine cats hem and haw, avoiding their baron's gaze.
At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron shares a humorous story about kits sneaking out of camp. m_c coldly replies that o_c_n should teach their kits to behave better.

At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron complains about rowdy kits disturbing their sleep. m_c rolls {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes and demands to know if o_c_n's baron never feels like singing at moonhigh. The answer is no, apparently.
Before the announcements begin at the Gathering, m_c tells a group of o_c_n apprentices stories of c_n's exploits. o_c_n's baron seems peeved that their apprentices now think m_c is cooler than them.
At the Gathering, m_c keeps asking why? in response to everything o_c_n's baron says. o_c_n's baron eventually breaks off with a hiss.
During the Gathering, m_c does {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} best to get on o_c_n's good side.

It occurs to m_c at the Gathering that o_c_n has never been on good terms with one other Clan. m_c spends {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} speech making veiled insults at that Clan, all the while cozying up to o_c_n's baron.
c_n and o_c_n arrive at the Gathering's meeting place at the same time; m_c halts the Clan with a tail-signal and gestures for o_c_n's baron to enter first.
During the Gathering, m_c nods and agrees when o_c_n's baron mentions diplomacy and inter-Clan friendship.
At the Gathering, m_c nudges {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates to go sit with o_c_nners and chat with them.
When o_c_n arrives at the Gathering, m_c shifts over to make plenty of room for their baron on the baron's perch. o_c_n's baron jumps up and dips their head to m_c.
During the Gathering, o_c_n's baron announces new clippers. m_c leads c_n in cheering their names.
During the Gathering, o_c_n's baron describes driving off some troublesome rogues. m_c nods {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} approval.
At the Gathering, m_c asks o_c_n's baron a few questions about themselves.
During the Gathering, m_c remarks that o_c_n's apprentices seem to be growing into fine young cats.
m_c takes o_c_n's baron aside at the Gathering to ask about resolving a particular dispute in c_n. o_c_n's baron, flattered, gives {PRONOUN/m_c/object} plenty of advice.
During the Gathering, m_c surprises and impresses o_c_n's baron by bringing up an obscure part of o_c_n's history.

The night before the Gathering, one of m_c's friends visits {PRONOUN/m_c/object} from StarClan and gives {PRONOUN/m_c/object} a pep talk, reminding {PRONOUN/m_c/object} what a good friend {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is}. m_c arrives at the Gathering with steeled nerves and strikes up conversation with o_c_n's baron

m_c brings a piece of willow bark with strange grooves on it to the Gathering. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/explain/explains} to the other barons that this is a sign of future prosperity for o_c_n and c_n - and only them.
During the Gathering, m_c brings up an old legend about two Clans that put aside their differences and formed an alliance, bringing strength to both of them. o_c_n's baron listens with interest.

At the Gathering, m_c pulls o_c_n's baron aside to warn them that fire may be a problem for o_c_n in the coming moons. o_c_n's baron seems skeptical as to how m_c could possibly know that, but nevertheless thanks {PRONOUN/m_c/object} for the heads-up.
At the Gathering, m_c pulls o_c_n's baron aside to warn them that a large dog may be a problem for o_c_n in the coming moons. o_c_n's baron agrees to be careful, thanking m_c for the heads-up.

Just as o_c_n arrives at the Gathering, m_c shouts a warning for o_c_n's baron to move. A heartbeat later, a dead branch plummets toward them, but o_c_n's baron leaps out of the way in the nick of time. o_c_n is shocked and relieved.

At the Gathering, o_c_n's baron struggles through a report that an entire litter of o_c_n kits were wiped out by kitten-cough. m_c draws them aside after and reassures them that the kittens are playing moss-ball together in StarClan. o_c_n's baron thanks {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, their mew thick with emotion.

When c_n arrives at the Gathering, m_c launches {PRONOUN/m_c/self} onto the baron's perch with a mighty leap. o_c_n's baron eyes the deep grooves {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} claws left behind in the earth and makes a mental note to stay on c_n's good side.
During the Gathering, m_c flatters o_c_n's baron with {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} attention. After all, m_c knows exactly how to handle short tempers and immature behavior.

m_c may be awkward with cats {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} age, but some things about socializing are true for all ages. At the Gathering, m_c expresses interest in all of o_c_n's baron's comments and opinions, and by the end of the night, o_c_n's baron has puffed up their chest.
